sections.title: Parameters
sections.description: Donor lifetime, Förster radius, the donor-acceptor distance and the quantities it determines. Edit any one of distance, lifetime, efficiency or rate and the others follow.

sections.label: Distance DA
sections.description: Donor-acceptor distance. Any of distance, lifetime, efficiency or rate may be entered; the others are recomputed.

sections.label: Lifetime DA
sections.description: Donor lifetime in the presence of acceptor (D in DA). Editable input that back-computes the distance.

sections.label: Efficiency
sections.description: FRET efficiency. Editable input that back-computes the distance.

sections.label: kFRET
sections.description: FRET rate constant. Editable input that back-computes the distance.

sections.label: σ
sections.description: Width of the donor-acceptor distance distribution.

sections.label: χ distribution
sections.description: Use a 3D non-central chi distance distribution instead of a Gaussian. Distances are never Gaussian: a Gaussian assigns weight to negative / near-zero distances, while the chi distribution is non-negative and vanishes at contact (R=0).

sections.title: Distributions
sections.description: The distance distribution and the FRET-rate distribution it induces, drawn in their own windows.

sections.title: Distance distribution
sections.description: Donor-acceptor distance distribution: Gaussian vs the non-negative chi distribution (active one solid).

sections.title: Rate-constant distribution
sections.description: FRET-rate-constant distribution induced by the distance distribution.
